## C2 — KG hints for Defensive Driving and Communication

FACT_ID: sec14-R01 | anchor: A01
Human error drives 94 percent of bad crashes, while safety-first habits blunt it [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint techniques; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec14-F01 and sec14-F02.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0047]

FACT_ID: sec14-R02 | anchor: A01
Mirrors and long scans feed awareness, while aggressive drivers get dodged by slowing or exiting [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint techniques; prereq_hint sec14-F02; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec14-F03 and sec14-F04.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0047]

FACT_ID: sec14-R03 | anchor: A01
Distrust plans for signal runners, while three-to-four-second gaps buy reaction time [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint techniques; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec14-F05 and sec14-F06.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0047]

FACT_ID: sec14-R04 | anchor: A01
Low speed, escape routes, and full focus close the seven, while limits alone never suffice [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint techniques; prereq_hint sec14-F06; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec14-F07 and sec14-F08.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0047]

FACT_ID: sec14-R05 | anchor: A02
Uniform lawful pace calms roads, while outliers multiply conflicts [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint traffic; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec14-F10.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0048]

FACT_ID: sec14-R06 | anchor: A02
Slow rigs wear orange triangles, while early spotting beats sudden braking [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint traffic; prereq_hint sec14-F10; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec14-F11 and sec14-F12.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0048]

FACT_ID: sec14-R07 | anchor: A02
Gaps stop tailgating crashes, while the tailgated edge right and telegraph moves [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint traffic; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec14-F13 and sec14-F14.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0048]

FACT_ID: sec14-R08 | anchor: A03
Presence and plans get broadcast, while headlights serve seeing and being seen [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint signals; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec14-F15 and sec14-F16.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec14-R09 | anchor: A03
Night and 500-foot murk mandate beams, while horns warn seven listed hazards [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint signals; prereq_hint sec14-F16; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec14-F17 and sec14-F18.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec14-R10 | anchor: A03
Breakdowns flee roadsides with blazing hazards, while lane strandings march out and call [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint breakdown; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec14-F20 and sec14-F21.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0049]
